summary: The protected owning plan selects eng/qualify-installed-python-hello.py for P4 source preparation, with prospective private-input generation portable-p4-python-private-inputs-20261006-diag-source3. It also attributes the typed intake validation/refusal/no-write account to the root report, with no independently retained result artifact or fresh board verification; filing and board state remain unverified. title: P4 source-route selection preserves independent native and adoption gates
